user: Cowork demo: TORGO speaker M04 (research recordings) plus everyday phrases and Mac actions
phrases: I'm thirsty, could I have some water?
I need to use the bathroom.
I'm in pain, I need help.
Grandfather likes to be modern in his language.
I feel I can play this weekend.
I just try to do my best.
It was a good win for us.
My sister made the flowered curtains.
We gathered shells on the beach.
Well he is nearly ninetythree years old.
You wished to know all about my grandfather.

commands.name: open_app
commands.description: Open an application on the Mac (only opens it).

args.app: Name of the app to open

commands.name: new_email
commands.description: Start ONE new email in Mail, with the cursor in To. Any wording: write an email, new email, new mail, compose, open a draft, new message.

commands.name: next_field
commands.description: In an email (or a form): move the cursor to the next box (To, Cc, Subject, message).

commands.name: previous_field
commands.description: In an email (or a form): move the cursor back to the previous box.

commands.name: go_to_field
commands.description: In an email: put the cursor in a box the person names (go to subject, go to the message).

commands.name: send_email
commands.description: Send the email that is open on screen.

commands.name: open_latest_email
commands.description: Open the newest email in the inbox in its own window (Mail), to look at it. Any wording: open my latest email, open the newest email, show my last email.

commands.name: read_latest_email
commands.description: Read the newest email OUT LOUD (only when the person asks to hear it: read out, read aloud).

commands.name: new_document
commands.description: Create a new blank document (Word, TextEdit, Pages). Any wording: new document, blank document, new page.

commands.name: save_document
commands.description: Save the document or file being worked on.

commands.name: new_tab
commands.description: Open a new tab in the web browser.

commands.name: search_for
commands.description: Type words to search for into the browser's address bar or the search box (it is run with "hit search").

commands.name: answer_question
commands.description: The person asks a QUESTION (what, who, when, where, how, why, is, will, can...), e.g. the weather, a fact, the time. Answer it; never type it.

commands.name: type_text
commands.description: Type words the person dictates. ONLY when they say type or write followed by the words, or when dictation is on and the cursor is in a text box. Never for a question or a command.

commands.name: quit_app
commands.description: Close (quit) an app by its name, e.g. close Word, quit Chrome, close Mail.

args.app: Name of the app to close

commands.name: reply_email
commands.description: Reply to the email that is open or selected in Mail (a reply opens, cursor in the message, nothing is sent).

commands.name: reply_all_email
commands.description: Reply to everyone on the email open in Mail.

commands.name: forward_email
commands.description: Forward the email open in Mail (opens a forward, nothing is sent).

commands.name: mark_unread
commands.description: Mark the email open or selected in Mail as unread.

commands.name: delete_email
commands.description: Delete (move to the Trash) the email open or selected in Mail.

commands.name: archive_email
commands.description: Archive the email open or selected in Mail.

commands.name: undo_edit
commands.description: Undo the last change in the document (Word, Notes, TextEdit).

commands.name: select_all
commands.description: Select everything in the document or text box.

commands.name: make_bold
commands.description: Make the selected text bold (or not bold).

commands.name: new_line
commands.description: Start a new line in the document or text box.

commands.name: new_paragraph
commands.description: Start a new paragraph (a blank line) in the document.

commands.name: reload_page
commands.description: Reload the web page (Chrome, Safari).

commands.name: close_tab
commands.description: Close the browser tab in front (Chrome, Safari).

commands.name: do_in_app
commands.description: Do something in the app in front that no other command covers, using that app's own menus and buttons (for example: print this, zoom in, add a bookmark, insert a table, show the sidebar, flag this email). Never for typing words, for questions, or for anything another command does.

args.request: What the person wants done, in their words

commands.name: close_app
commands.description: Close (quit) the app the person is using right now, when they do not name an app (close the app, close this).

commands.name: scroll_up
commands.description: Scroll the page up. The person says: up.

commands.name: scroll_down
commands.description: Scroll the page down. The person says: down.

commands.name: go_back
commands.description: Go back to the previous page. The person says: back.

commands.name: go_forward
commands.description: Go forward to the next page. The person says: forward.

commands.name: press_left
commands.description: Press the left arrow key (previous item). The person says: left.

commands.name: press_right
commands.description: Press the right arrow key (next item). The person says: right.

commands.name: press_return
commands.description: Press Return (Enter) in the app being typed into, e.g. to run a search. The person says: hit search, press enter, select.
